# cofide_connect_cloud_organizations (Data Source)

Provides information about Cofide Connect cloud organizations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "org_ids" {
  description = "Filter by Cofide organization IDs."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = ["example-org-id"]
}


data "cofide_connect_cloud_organizations" "example" {
  org_ids = var.org_ids
}


output "cloud_organizations" {
  description = "The list of cloud organizations."
  value       = data.cofide_connect_cloud_organizations.example.cloud_organizations
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_ids` (List of String) Filter by Cofide organization IDs.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_organizations` (Attributes List) The list of cloud organizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_organizations`

Read-Only:

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS-specific configuration for the cloud organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_organizations--aws))
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of resource creation.
- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this cloud organization.
- `id` (String) The ID of the cloud organization.
- `last_discovered_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last resource update.
- `name` (String) The name of the cloud organization.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Cofide organization this cloud organization belongs to.
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_organizations--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_organizations.aws`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call.
- `aws_org_id` (String) The AWS Organization ID (e.g. `o-xxxxxxxxxx`).
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume when discovering resources in this cloud organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_organizations--aws--role_chain))

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_organizations--aws--role_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_organizations.aws.role_chain`

Read-Only:

- `external_id` (String) Optional external ID for confused-deputy protection.
- `iam_role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role to assume.
